Greek Salad with Lemon Dressing
Yield: 4 servings
INGREDIENTS
For the dressing:
▢ ¼ cup extra-virgin olive oil
▢ 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
▢ 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice
▢ 1 clove garlic, minced
▢ ½ teaspoon dried oregano
▢ Salt and black pepper, to taste
For the salad:
▢ 1 large English cucumber, halved and sliced
▢ 2 cups cherry tomatoes, halved
▢ ½ red onion, thinly sliced
▢ 1 green bell pepper, chopped
▢ ½ cup Kalamata olives
▢ 4 oz feta cheese, cubed
INSTRUCTIONS
Make the dressing: In a small jar, combine the olive oil, vinegar, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper. Shake well.
In a large bowl, combine the cucumber, tomatoes, onion, bell pepper and olives.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently. Top with the feta and serve.
